svg.title: Left: the ζ-plane, with a circle of radius a centred at μ, left of and above the origin, passing through ζ = b and enclosing ζ = −b; the radius to ζ = b lies at angle β below the horizontal. Right: its image under the Karman–Trefftz map z = f(ζ), a cambered airfoil whose trailing edge, of angle τ, is the image of ζ = b at z = nb.
svg.text: ζ-plane: circle of radius a through ζ = b
z-plane: airfoil, trailing edge at z = nb
